newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty closes softer amid small foreign withdrawal.
newsitem.headline: Zloty closes softer amid small foreign withdrawal.

text.p: 1230 GMT - The Polish zloty closed at 1.08/0.97 pct from the trading band centre, weaker than Thursday's 1.15/1.03 pct close. Zloty stabilised around psychological support at one pct from parity following early lows around 0.7 pct from parity.
* Some foreigners sold short-term Polish paper in early trade, but no large sale orders were placed, dealers said.
* It closed at 3.2595/45 to the dollar, down from 3.2570/00 on Thursday and at 1.8850/60 to the mark, down from 1.8778/83.
* O/N close lower at 21.75/22.75 pct on last working day of June's reserve period. T/N at 22.10/22.60 pct vs Thursday's 22.80/24.05 pct. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
